sv.title: Explosion vid flerfamiljehus i Helsingborg
sv.summary: En explosion har inträffat vid ett flerfamiljehus i Dalhem, Helsingborg, under natten mot onsdagen.

en.title: Explosion at apartment building in Helsingborg
en.summary: An explosion has occurred at an apartment building in Dalhem, Helsingborg, during the night to Wednesday.
